record.chaining: 150 images a day, generated into a public gallery, is a slow synthetic-image feed for a training set; pair it with a free object store and a free runner to pull the outputs, since the free plan gives no bulk download. What breaks: the 'Auto Only' model lock and the 'Basic' quality setting, which means the images are not the model version a paid plan would give, and any dataset that needs a specific checkpoint cannot be built here at all.

record.notes: These are inference credits, not general compute. The vendor page proves 150 tokens a day; what a token buys comes from the vendor's help centre rather than the pricing page: one token per standard 768x768 image, 2 for background removal, 5 for an upscale, 40 for a Nano Banana image (reported via a Portuguese-language review read 2026-10-22, dated 2026-09-20, which cites the vendor Token Usage table). So the honest range is 3 images a day on the most expensive model to 150 a day at one token. Not established: whether signup demands a card; the pricing page does not say.
